memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Avery changed only the outbound flight to reach Denver in time for the rescheduled Monday crate delivery. The Thursday return and three-night Catbird stay remain intact; an early-arrival request and complimentary luggage storage were confirmed for Monday morning.

messages.content: The carrier just moved the Denver crate delivery to Monday at 4:30 p.m. I need to be at the gallery that afternoon, so the 11:05 Delta flight will not work anymore. Can you see what earlier Delta options can replace only the outbound? Keep Thursday evening coming home.

I’ll check same-day Delta options from Atlanta to Denver for Monday, August 18, while leaving the Thursday, August 21, 6:40 p.m. return unchanged. I’ll also confirm the change cost before modifying ticket H7Q4LM.
Please look for something that gets me there by late morning. Nonstop would be best for this crate handoff.

Delta has a nonstop leaving Atlanta at 7:10 a.m. Monday and arriving Denver at 8:32 a.m. The next nonstop arrives at 11:18 a.m. The 7:10 flight has Main Cabin availability and would add $38 to the ticket; Delta is not showing a separate change fee. The 11:18 arrival would add $24.
Use the 7:10. I don’t want the later one to leave too little room if there is a delay. Is the checked-bag estimate still the same?

Yes. One checked bag remains noted in the itinerary, with the same expected $35 charge in each direction unless a waiver applies. Changing to the 7:10 a.m. outbound raises the airfare from $446 to $484, so the projected flight, hotel, and bag total becomes $1,228.22. That remains within the $1,250 approval.
Go ahead and make that flight change, but do not touch the Thursday return.

The outbound has been changed. Delta confirmation H7Q4LM now shows Atlanta to Denver on Monday, August 18, departing at 7:10 a.m. and arriving at 8:32 a.m. The Thursday, August 21, 6:40 p.m. Denver-to-Atlanta nonstop remains unchanged. Delta charged the $38 fare difference to the original payment method, and no insurance or other extras were added.
Now check Catbird. I’ll get there well before normal check-in. Can they either let me into the studio early or hold my suitcase while I go to the gallery? Same three nights.

Catbird confirms reservation CB-481730 still covers August 18-21 for the same standard studio and total of $674.22. Standard check-in begins at 4:00 p.m. They can add an early-arrival request, but early room access cannot be guaranteed and would depend on availability that morning. The front desk will hold your luggage at no charge until the room is ready.
Add the early-arrival request, then. I can leave the suitcase if the room is not ready. There is no change to the price or cancellation terms, correct?

Correct. The request does not change the rate, room type, dates, or cancellation deadline. The reservation remains cancelable without charge until 6:00 p.m. Denver time on August 17. I’ve added an expected arrival around 9:30 a.m. and noted that you will use complimentary luggage storage if the studio is unavailable.
Good. Give me the final schedule and charges in one place so I can send it to the registrar.

Delta confirmation H7Q4LM now departs Atlanta Monday, August 18, at 7:10 a.m. and arrives Denver at 8:32 a.m.; the return remains Thursday, August 21, at 6:40 p.m., arriving Atlanta at 11:32 p.m. The revised airfare is $484 after the $38 additional charge. Catbird confirmation CB-481730 remains one standard studio for August 18-21 at $674.22, with a 9:30 a.m. early-arrival request and complimentary luggage storage confirmed if the room is not ready. Estimated checked-bag charges remain $70 total unless waived. The projected trip total is $1,228.22, within the $1,250 approval.
